key.name: show-overlay-keybinding
key.description: Keybinding to manually show the Pulse notes overlay.

key.name: overlay-position-x
key.description: Persisted X position of the overlay after dragging. -1 means unset (use default top-right position).

key.name: overlay-position-y
key.description: Persisted Y position of the overlay after dragging. -1 means unset (use default top-right position).
